title: Representation and continuity of a small-space-valued coherent presheaf
statement: Fix nested universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ and let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory in the ambient universe, using the coherent functors, transformations, opposite, mapping spaces and comma cones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ be the category of small spaces of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], viewed in the ambient universe, and $H:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ a coherent functor. For a normalized coherent Hom bifunctor $M$ as in [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality] and a vertex $c$ of $\mathcal C$, define the represented presheaf by fixing the second variable, $M(-,c)$. Define representability of $H$ to mean that there exist such $M$ and $c$ and a coherent natural equivalence $H\simeq M(-,c)$. Define $H$ to take small colimits to limits if for every small simplicial set $I$ (smallness as in [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]), every coherent diagram $F:I\to\mathcal C$ and every colimiting cocone $t:F\to\Delta_I a$, its contravariant image is a limiting cone on $H\circ F^{\mathrm{op}}$. This image cone has apex $H(a)$ and its entire coherent transformation is obtained by reversing the original parameter simplex and interval and then applying $H$. The condition tests all small indexing simplicial sets, including the empty one. No colimit or limit object is chosen.
